attacks.name: Shattering Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, this character Pushes the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Let me Show You Your Flaw
steps: When calculating successes for this attack, this character adds the number of |!failure| in both the attack and defense rolls to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Meditate
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character gains 2 |!power|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Teachings of the Three Worlds
superPowers.body: After another allied character within |!range| 3 makes an attack or defense roll, during the |*Calculate Success| step, this character may use this superpower. The allied character may add up to 2 of their |!failure| results to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Pinpoint Weakness
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved or this character resolves an attack, it may use this superpower. Place a |<weakness>Weakness| token on or move an existing Weakness token to the attacking or defending enemy character. This character may only have 1 Weakness token in play at a time.

superPowers.name: Analyzing Strike
superPowers.body: When this character attacks or defends against an attack from an enemy character with a |<weakness>Weakness| token, this character rolls 3 additional dice. Before |!damage| is dealt, the Weakness token is removed.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
